meta.name: capital-structure-and-covenants
meta.description: Decides how the business is financed and what that financing then requires of it — debt versus equity, weighted average cost of capital as a hurdle rate, how much leverage cash flow can carry, and the financial, affirmative and negative covenants, definitions, test dates and cure rights that come attached. Use this to evaluate a financing option, set an investment hurdle, check whether a planned decision will trip a covenant, or work out what a lender can do when one breaks.

copy.tagline: 判断融资方案是否可行并检验债务契约风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在融资前需要评估资本结构与契约约束
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate financing options and check covenant risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess capital structure and covenants before financing

howto.what: 它会分析融资方案,权衡债务与股权,计算加权平均资本成本作为投资门槛;还会评估现金流能承受的杠杆,梳理财务、义务性和限制性契约条款,并在违约前后给出应对建议。
howto.when: 当你要求评估融资选项、设定投资门槛,或检查决策是否会触发契约等融资合规问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我算这家公司的加权平均资本成本,并判断年化回报12%的投资值不值得做。
say.note: 会给出 WACC 计算和投资门槛判断。

say.text: 如果明年新增2亿有息负债,会不会违反杠杆率契约?哪天测试?
say.note: 会逐项比照契约定义和测试日期。

say.text: 我们预计下季度可能触发利息覆盖率,该什么时候联系贷款机构?
say.note: 会建议在测试日前沟通并说明补救权利。

howto.what_en: Analyzes financing choices, weighs debt vs equity, computes WACC as an investment hurdle, tests how much leverage cash flow can carry, reviews financial/affirmative/negative covenants, and outlines lender options if a covenant is breached.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to evaluate a financing option, set an investment hurdle, or check whether a decision trips a covenant or other financing-compliance issue.

say_en.text: Calculate this company's WACC: is a 12% annual return over the hurdle?
say_en.note: Returns WACC and a hurdle decision.

say_en.text: If we add $200M debt next year, will we breach a covenant? Test date?
say_en.note: Compares forecast headroom against covenant definitions.

say_en.text: We may breach interest coverage next quarter; when should we call the lender?
say_en.note: Advises pre-test-date contact and outlines cure rights.
